claim_text: We remain committed to the rehabilitation of the Ranger Project Area to a standard that will establish an environment similar to the adjacent Kakadu National Park, a World Heritage site.
context_text: We remain committed to the rehabilitation of the Ranger Project Area to a standard that will establish an environment similar to the adjacent Kakadu National Park, a World Heritage site.；In 2025, we met our guidance provided to the market in 2024, spending ~$1 billion on closure activities as we progressively rehabilitate our operations and progress work at Argyle, Ranger, the Gove alumina refinery and legacy sites.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告提供了closure spend，但没有给出能够证明Ranger已达到接近Kakadu环境状态的实际生态结果数据。
notes: commitment型表述；支出不是该环境结果的直接证据。
llm_reason: The claim asserts a commitment to rehabilitate the Ranger Project Area to a standard similar to Kakadu National Park. The evidence only states that the company spent ~$1 billion on closure activities across multiple sites, including Ranger, but provides no factual information about the rehabilitation standard achieved or progress toward the specific goal of establishing an environment similar to Kakadu. The evidence does not substantiate the decisive assertion of achieving a specific environmental standard.
